_readme: Every {{TOKEN}} in src/ is replaced from this file at build time. This is the
'set it once' file site-content.md asks for: a rename or a price change is one
edit here, not a crawl through markup.
PRODUCT was a literal placeholder until Aug 16 2026. The name was settled as
Dogear on Aug 12 2026 (Project-Rascal docs/decisions-log.md, closing open
item 1), so the site now says it. The App Store listing collision noted in
seo-plan.md is a marketing problem, not a naming one anymore.
ORIGIN is empty on purpose. The moment it holds a real https origin the build
starts emitting self-referencing canonicals, absolute OG image URLs and
sitemap.xml. Until then nothing fake ships. Nothing else needs to change.
CTA_SUPPORT: One a day, by email. A note when it opens and when the price goes live. Nothing else.
_cta_note: CTA describes the outcome, which is only honest if the daily waitlist email
actually ships. If it doesn't: set CTA to 'Join the waitlist' and CTA_SUPPORT
to "We'll email when it opens and when pricing goes live. Nothing else."
That is the whole revert -- both strings live here and nowhere else.
